title: 新旧随机数 API：全局态 vs 封装流
expected_output:
legacy reproducible = True
modern equal stream = True
different seed differ = True
code:
import numpy as np
# 旧式：全局可变状态
np.random.seed(0)
legacy1 = np.random.randn(3)
np.random.seed(0)
legacy2 = np.random.randn(3)
print("legacy reproducible =", np.allclose(legacy1, legacy2))
# 新式：封装 Generator
g1 = np.random.default_rng(7)
g2 = np.random.default_rng(7)
print("modern equal stream =", np.array_equal(g1.standard_normal(3), g2.standard_normal(3)))
g3 = np.random.default_rng(1)
g4 = np.random.default_rng(2)
print("different seed differ =", not np.array_equal(g3.standard_normal(3), g4.standard_normal(3)))
